Clossys Studio in 60 seconds. You start with a brief. Director turns it into direction: brand, voice, audience and proposition, each as a slot. Designer picks visuals from trusted references, and Writer writes copy that cites the brief. Publisher assembles each page from a frame and sections. Then the page is published. In Studio, every slot shows its candidates, its pin and where it came from.
Every publication with the root its config names and every route after it: the page that renders each path, its frame and sections, and the leaf that records it.
